two_piece.basis: Business share of revenue at each report: more than 40% in March, the majority by mid-August, and about 53% in late September after business revenue more than doubled while the total rose 70%. The business piece moves with developer signals, using the elasticity fitted on Anthropic, a business that is almost entirely usage-based. The consumer piece is held at its last reported level because no public signal tracks paid ChatGPT subscriptions.

rows.name: Subscriptions
rows.basis: Floor: more than 50M consumer subscribers in February at the $20 list price is $12B a year. Ceiling: business was the majority of revenue by August and has more than doubled since July, so consumer plus advertising is under half.

rows.name: Advertising
rows.basis: $1B run rate disclosed on 31 August. No later figure; the upper bound allows for a month of growth.

rows.name: Direct API
rows.basis: OpenAI has not disclosed how business revenue divides between direct API, enterprise seats and Azure resale. The default of half is a placeholder, not an estimate.

rows.name: Enterprise seats and Azure resale
rows.basis: Total minus Part 1: the share of run rate from enterprise seats and Azure resale. Nothing public measures it.
rows.label: Enterprise seats and Azure resale

signals.label: Anthropic

rows.name: Subscriptions
rows.basis: Subscriptions were $789M of nearly $4.6B in 2025, or 17%. Usage revenue has grown faster in 2026, so the lower bound allows the share to have slipped to 12%.

rows.name: Direct API
rows.basis: Whatever is neither subscriptions nor cloud resale. Cloud partners took 47% of sales in 2025 after rising every year; allowing 47% to 55% for 2026 leaves 28% to 41% billed directly.

rows.name: Cloud resale through Amazon, Google and Microsoft
rows.basis: Total minus Part 1: the share of run rate sold through Amazon, Google and Microsoft. The prospectus puts Amazon and Google at 47% of 2025 sales; no public signal tracks spending inside those clouds.
rows.label: Through cloud partners

sources.name: Company disclosures and press
sources.access: Manual review, graded A to D
sources.measures: Stated run-rate totals, segment figures and customer counts
sources.blind_spot: Unaudited, rounded, thresholds rather than exact values; observation date often unclear

sources.name: npm registry downloads
sources.measures: Daily downloads of the official SDKs, the Vercel AI SDK provider packages and the coding CLIs
sources.blind_spot: Installs, CI and updates are not paid usage; native installers divert downloads; OpenAI-compatible SDK is used with other providers

sources.name: Tranco domain ranking
sources.cadence: Daily lists; sampled month-end and weekly
sources.measures: Popularity rank of chatgpt.com, openai.com, claude.ai, anthropic.com
sources.blind_spot: Ordinal rank, not traffic; says nothing about paid conversion. Already blends Cloudflare Radar, Chrome UX, Majestic, Umbrella and Farsight rankings, so those are not separate sources

sources.name: Ramp AI Index (public pages)
sources.access: Published aggregates embedded in public pages; no private records
sources.measures: Share of Ramp businesses paying each vendor; token volume and billed token cost in Ramp's sample
sources.blind_spot: US-centric sample of Ramp customers; history is latest-vintage and can be revised; one payment is not a seat count

sources.name: PyPI downloads
sources.access: Open API, no key; about 180 days of history, rate limited
sources.measures: Downloads of the openai and anthropic Python SDKs
sources.blind_spot: Same install-versus-usage gap as npm; mirrors and CI inflate counts

sources.name: Open VSX installs (snapshot)
sources.cadence: Daily snapshot (no public history; must be collected forward)
sources.measures: Cumulative downloads of the Claude Code and ChatGPT/Codex editor extensions on Open VSX
sources.blind_spot: Cumulative and one registry only; the Microsoft marketplace is not included. Not active paid seats

sources.name: Homebrew analytics (snapshot)
sources.measures: Installs of the codex, claude-code, chatgpt and claude casks over 30, 90 and 365 days
sources.blind_spot: macOS and Linux developers who have not opted out of analytics

sources.name: GitHub stars (snapshot)
sources.measures: Stars on the official SDK and CLI repositories
sources.blind_spot: Interest, not spending; stars are cumulative and gameable

sources.name: Wikipedia pageviews
sources.measures: Views of the ChatGPT and Claude articles on English Wikipedia
sources.blind_spot: Curiosity and news cycles, not product use

sources.name: App Store charts and rating counts (snapshot)
sources.access: Apple public chart feeds and lookup service; no public history
sources.measures: Chart position and cumulative rating count of the ChatGPT and Claude iOS apps in six countries
sources.blind_spot: Rank reflects new downloads and ratings reflect past users; neither measures subscribers or revenue. iOS only

sources.name: OpenRouter rankings (snapshot)
sources.access: Public rankings page; robots.txt allows it
sources.cadence: Weekly snapshot of the top 20 models and apps
sources.measures: OpenAI and Anthropic share of tokens among the top 20 models, and tokens used by the Codex and Claude Code apps
sources.blind_spot: Router users skew to hobbyist and price-sensitive workloads; not representative of enterprise contracts

sources.name: Vercel AI Gateway index
sources.access: Monthly public reports, transcribed by hand
sources.measures: Provider share of tokens and of list-price-valued spend through one gateway
sources.blind_spot: Gateway sample; list prices ignore discounts and credits; prior periods are revised

sources.name: Cloud provider earnings releases
sources.access: Company releases and SEC filings, transcribed by hand
sources.measures: Quarterly cloud revenue and growth at Amazon, Alphabet and Microsoft
